assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The required precertification or prior authorization was missing at the time of service
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained or submitted prior to the service date
Coverage for the procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The member retains the right to appeal this determination

Detailed instructions regarding the appeals process, including necessary documentation and submission deadlines, are available in the member's Summary of Benefits and Coverage or by contacting Member Services directly
